confidence_limits: No new training, fitted diagnostic classifier, architecture prototype, input ablation, tensor mutation, or Brev run was performed in M3DH.

The packet can rank explanations from existing evidence but cannot isolate architecture capacity from optimization, input signal, or dataset diversity without a fresh strategy review or future explicitly approved experiment.
Current evidence does not justify product recognition claims, model promotion, export, or final-gate changes.
current_strongest_explanation.rationale: M3DD-M3DG show that a materially revised no-pretrained motion/region/token scaffold still fails at train/validation/test chance-level behavior and contains nonseparable train representations before the classifier. Prior local receipts reduce mechanical loader, split, label, tensor, sampler, loss, checkpoint, threshold, classifier-bias, and last-layer-only explanations. The remaining plausible axis is a post-scaffold architecture/input/optimization/data envelope failure, but the only current strategy memo and design/contract chain predates this scaffold failure and produced the failed scaffold route.

decision.rationale: The M3DH packet is complete and the next meaningful change would reassess architecture, input representation, optimization/training strategy, product scope, or compute route after a second failed representation-collapse path.
